name: warn_explicit
reason: pyWarnExplicit merges duck typing into fixed errors: a registry that is not a dict is always AttributeError (RegArg.obj), though any mapping with get/clear/__setitem__ works at :568-575 (likewise _wm.onceregistry), and every non-str action falls through to RuntimeError, though an unhashable one raises TypeError at 'action in {"always", "all"}' (:601); linecache.getlines and WarningMessage(...) are folded into the show callback shared with C.
